meta.name: linkedin
meta.description: Post updates to a LinkedIn company page. Use for sharing blog posts, product updates, AI-generated content, and company announcements. Supports text posts, article shares with link previews, and image posts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发布内容到领英公司主页
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想管理公司领英主页并定期发布更新
copy.tagline_en: Post updates to your LinkedIn company page
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage a company LinkedIn page and need to post updates regularly

howto.what: 启用后,它能直接把文字、带链接的文章或图片发到领英公司主页,发前校验令牌,发后可查最近动态或删帖。
howto.when: 当你想把博客文章、产品更新、AI 生成内容等公司动态发到领英公司主页时触发;需先配置 LINKEDIN_ACCESS_TOKEN 和 LINKEDIN_ORG_ID。

say.text: 把这篇博客文章分享到公司领英页,生成链接预览。
say.note: 会创建带标题和摘要的链接卡片。

say.text: 在领英公司页发一张产品图,配文简单介绍它。
say.note: 会先上传图片,再发布带图动态。

say.text: 列出领英公司页最近发布的帖子。
say.note: 调用接口抓取最近动态。

howto.what_en: Once enabled, Claude can post text updates, article links with previews, or images to your LinkedIn company page. It verifies the access token before posting, and can list recent posts or delete them.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to share blog posts, product updates, or AI-generated content to your LinkedIn company page. Requires LINKEDIN_ACCESS_TOKEN and LINKEDIN_ORG_ID.

say_en.text: Share this blog post to our LinkedIn page with a link preview.
Post a product photo to LinkedIn with a short caption.
Show the recent posts from our LinkedIn page.
